claim.text: The struck vehicle became a hazard at 5.9 s by closing within the ego lane.
Perception took 0.1764 s, below the 0.3 s threshold.
Command took 0.0498 s, below the 0.1 s threshold.
Brake actuation took 0.12 s, below the 0.25 s threshold.
Impact occurred 2.1 s after hazard onset.
The witness and the recheck agree that the other vehicle's brake lights were not on.
With nominal perception 0.2 s, command 0.05 s and tau 0.15 s, contact still occurred in the counterfactual.
The nominal counterfactual impact speed was 3.589 m/s, supporting an unavoidable contact.
